changelog.entry: New: in Settings, a Confirmations row lists any question you switched off with 'don't ask again' (finishing a run, retiring the last unit of a plant type) and an Ask me again button turns them all back on. Retiring from two or more units of a type is still instant; only the last unit asks.

New: an optional Coach. Turn it on in Settings and a small panel gives one plain sentence each time you look: what is short, which fleet is wearing out and what maintaining it costs, what is driving your disruption risk, or that spare funds could go into a renewable that keeps getting cheaper. It never blocks anything and it is off until you switch it on. Settings, Reset to Default now also puts your display choices back.
Changed: on a phone, the bar that stays pinned at the top while you scroll now shows the round and your capacity as well as funds, demand and emissions (it scrolls sideways when it is full).

New: Fleet overview, a sortable table under Plant Mix. Every plant type on one row: units, wear, the chance of an aging breakdown, when its auto-maintain pass next runs, and what it earns per round. Press a column heading to sort by it, press again to reverse.

New: you choose what the trend graph shows. Tick or untick Emissions, Renewable cost, Global benchmark, plus three new lines (Funds, Demand and Clean share); each line has its own colour and its own dash pattern, and the best-round diamond stays on whichever line is showing. Ghost run draws your best earlier run's clean share and funds as faint lines and says in words whether you are ahead or behind it. Show charts as tables swaps the trend graph, the plant-mix bars and the gauges for plain tables with a one-line description of the trend. Your choices are kept on this device.

New: a screen reader now hears what changes. After you build, retire or maintain a plant, advance or auto-advance rounds, invest in demand response, answer a policy lever or grant, or unlock an achievement, a short plain sentence says what happened: the round recap, any disruption or breakdown, demand against capacity, the renewable and fossil shares and your funds. A refused action says why. Each plant row is now a named group so its Build, Retire and Maintain buttons say which plant they belong to, and keyboard focus shows a thick yellow ring.

New: a practice sandbox. Press Practice sandbox (Desktop: Menu, Game) to try anything on a separate grid with unlimited funds, no disruptions or breakdowns, every upgrade-tree perk and loadout switched on, and a scenario button that restarts the practice grid at any time. A banner says Sandbox: nothing here is saved, and nothing in it earns an achievement or touches your career. Leave sandbox puts your real game back exactly as it was; saving while you are in it saves your real game.

Big update, three parts. (1) Every run now has a short seed such as GRID-K7F2Q, shown under Run setup: the same seed and the same choices give the same weather, disruptions and breakdowns, and you can type a friend's seed before you build. (2) Your Career is now an upgrade tree: the four old perks are its first nodes, a Projects branch (wind and solar site leases, storage subsidy, R&D grant, policy liaison) lets you buy named permanent modifiers on purpose, a Starting loadout branch (Old Coal Contract, Storage Startup, Diplomatic Immunity) lets you pick how a run begins, and a Meteorology branch unlocks Peek forecast, a small fee to read next round's weather and whether a disruption hits. After you finish a run, a What if panel replays the same seed under three other strategies so you can see what each would have earned. (3) Play changes: a Perfect Round streak raises your revenue after rounds with no disruption and demand met, Undo last build is free within the round (an opt-in Ironman toggle turns it off), every plant has a nickname and the last coal plant gets a eulogy, occasional surprise grants offer a two-button choice, hovering the plant-mix bars shows each type's share of capacity, revenue and emissions, and the What's New panel now says when a loaded save had missing fields repaired.

New: the Run Summary has a Copy result button that copies one line, such as Grid, 62 clean-grid score, with your round, operator grade and emissions avoided. Every achievement you have earned now has a Share button that copies a line you can paste anywhere, with the share of players who have it when that figure is available. The How to Play and Info panels link to the new Credits page.

Career and quality-of-life update: your Career panel now keeps a run history with stacked comparison charts, lifetime statistics with a clean-share heatmap, personal records (fewest rounds to 90% clean, longest disruption-free streak) with a New record! flash, and locked perks show their effect and how many points away they are. You can export, import or reset your career (reset offers a backup first). New: Auto-advance plays up to five rounds and stops at the first disruption, breakdown or policy offer; a round recap line explains where last round's funds went; and Relaxed, Standard and Operator difficulty presets set the existing difficulty controls in one choice.

Desktop layout: on a wide window with a mouse you can now play Grid in a full-window layout, with your numbers as chips across the top, one row per plant type, and Advance Round, risk, trends and your score in a side column. Everything else (compare grids, career, achievements, settings) opens as a window from the Menu. Your saves work in both layouts, and Classic is still there.
Story mode: a running story about a small valley utility, told in 18 short chapters that unlock as you earn each achievement. The new Story pill hides it (W1).

Real grid comparison: pick the United States (2025), Germany (2025) or France (2020) and see your plant mix beside that region's published generation mix, with a per-source gap and a plain verdict on how much cleaner or dirtier your grid is. Sources are named on screen (C29).
Regional grid: connect a smaller neighbouring grid that leans on your own spare capacity instead of building its own plants (C3).
Shadow grid: pick a different starting scenario and a non-interactive twin grid copies every build and retire you make, with a side-by-side comparison (C21).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
New achievement, Stored Power: build your first battery storage.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/What's New panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.

Added a Grid Operator Career (finish a run to bank career points, then spend them on four small permanent perks; achievements now persist across runs), storage arbitrage (charge batteries from surplus, discharge into a shortfall at a peak price), and an opt-in Emergency response starting scenario. Demand response, policy levers, the weather log and auto-maintain schedules are now saved too.
Each plant type now has its own auto-maintain schedule (Manual / every 3 / 5 / 8 rounds), finishing the maintenance-scheduling feature whose backend landed in the previous entry without a UI yet.

Added demand response (a fourth build/retire/maintain-style lever that permanently trims demand growth), a weather-event log narrating how Weather Variability actually affected renewable output round to round, and a periodic policy lever (opt-in carbon pricing or a renewable subsidy, both temporary build-cost shifts).

Added starting scenarios, operator letter grade, grid resilience score, 20-round projection, best-round trend marker, funds bar visuals, clean-streak counter, wear tier glyphs and tooltips, and 'why it happened' disruption toasts.
Retire-button tooltip added: states the 50%-of-current-cost refund rule permanently, not just in a one-time callout.
Shared confirm-dialog integration: retiring a plant type's last unit now asks for confirmation.
Settings panel added: text size (A-/A/A+) and a reduce-motion toggle, both persisted per-browser.
Colorblind-safety audit: fixed a red/green trend-graph line pair (cost line recolored to blue, plus a dash pattern).
Space theme visual pass: starfield background, glass panels, gradient buttons.
Code-quality audits: fixed a retire-refund exploit (refunded off current cost, not flat base cost) and a save/load merge bug.
Pass 3 (fun/teaching balance): added a live disruption-risk message tying rising emissions to brownout chance.
Info Page added with curated real-world sources on energy-sector emissions and renewable cost curves.
Pass 2: global-comparison benchmark line and infrastructure aging/vulnerability.
Pass 1: live emissions/renewable-cost trend graph and a first-unlock context blurb.
All 6 milestones complete: core state loop, emissions + cost curve, disruption events, scoring, feedback prompt, visual pass + hub integration.
